summary: Full backend + frontend testing of the admin manager Preview/Publish/Unpublish flow. 7/7 backend pytest cases pass; all frontend UI flows (bulk preview modal with draft banner, quick-edit preview-on-site link, bulk publish, bulk unpublish, storefront regression) pass. Fixture TEST-DRAFT-PO1 left UNPUBLISHED at the end as required.

backend.test_preview_shows_draft_for_unpublished: PASS - draft_count>=1, TEST-DRAFT-PO1 present with is_draft:true
backend.test_publish_then_unpublish_draft_sku: PASS - full round-trip; SP.published toggles True->False; draft re-appears after unpublish

frontend.bulk_preview_modal: PASS - modal opens, unpublished badge shows 'X selected products aren't live yet - shown below as draft previews', iframe src=/shop/collection/Premium%20Oak?preview=1, preview-draft-banner rendered inside iframe with correct copy
frontend.bulk_publish_ui: PASS - POST /api/supplier-sync/publish-to-website returned 200; SKU removed from draft list; SP.published=true; live_slug=premium-oak-signature-plank-60x60
frontend.bulk_unpublish_ui: PASS - DELETE /api/supplier-sync/unpublish-from-website returned 200; SKU back as draft; SP.published=false
frontend.storefront_regression_60x60_porcelain: PASS - normal page renders, no draft banner, products present

critical_code_review_comments: supplier_sync.py and tiles.py are large monolithic files (both well over 2000 lines) - future refactor into feature modules recommended
Draft merge in _get_collection_products_impl relies on case-sensitive series match; may want case-insensitive lookup for user-typed series names in preview URL
Bulk publish/unpublish uses window.confirm - fine for admin, but consider a styled shadcn dialog for consistency
seed_data_creation: None - used existing fixture TEST-DRAFT-PO1 (series 'Premium Oak'). Fixture left UNPUBLISHED (no tiles doc) at end of run.

Bulk bar test-ids: bar-preview, bar-publish, bar-unpublish. Series checkbox: tiles-series-check-<Series>. Draft banner inside storefront iframe: preview-draft-banner. Confirms use window.confirm - auto-accept via page.on('dialog').
